records.name: Anointing
records.meaning: Anoints a friendly target, increasing damage, healing, and casting speed by 20% for 15 sec.
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square fantasy MMO ability icon readable at 24 pixels.
Primary request: Anointing, a blessing that improves an ally. Show one simple upright light ivory oil flask, with a short neck and wide rounded body, and one large bold golden droplet floating clearly beside it. The flask and droplet must be separate, strongly contrasting shapes. Fill most of the frame with these two forms.
Style: original painterly dark fantasy art, broad shapes, restrained gold highlights on pale ceramic, dark blue-black background. Legibility in grayscale and at 24 pixels takes priority over ornament or effects.
Constraints: no flames, no hands, no characters, no heart, no shield, no lettering, no border, no watermark. No copyrighted visual references or image inputs.
